name: Murcia

queries.query: Murcia Spain official cadastral map parcel GIS API Catastro Murcia Ayuntamiento
queries.result: First-party results identified the Ayuntamiento de Murcia geovisor, the municipal Geoportal service directory, the SITAM ArcGIS parcel layer, and Spain's Dirección General del Catastro WMS/INSPIRE services.

queries.query: Murcia visor cartográfico parcelas catastro Ayuntamiento de Murcia
queries.result: Las fuentes oficiales muestran el Visor cartográfico del Ayuntamiento de Murcia, su Geoportal y un servicio SITAM de parcelas públicas. El visor expone búsquedas por referencia catastral y descarga GeoJSON, pero no se obtuvo una respuesta anónima de parcela segura desde su interfaz; el servicio SITAM consultado no devolvió una entidad en el punto WUP.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Ayuntamiento de Murcia; Servicio Central de Cartografía e Información Urbanística
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: The public municipal viewer identifies EPSG:25830, supports coordinate and cadastral-reference searches, and advertises vector download including GeoJSON. It is a local municipal map/procedure custodian, but its current page did not provide a directly inspectable parcel response in this bounded anonymous attempt.

The official directory identifies municipal WMS publication through geoserver.murcia.es/geoserver/wms and describes the Geoportal as the municipal spatial-data dissemination channel. The listed public layers were not asserted to be cadastral parcel geometry.

Public ArcGIS Feature Layer named parcelas_publicas_shp, polygon geometry, query formats JSON/GeoJSON/PBF, source spatial reference EPSG:25830. Safe fields include FID, fid_1, refcat, and geometry; the layer also exposes potentially unsafe descriptive fields, which were not requested.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Dirección General del Catastro, Ministerio de Hacienda
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: National first-party cadastral WMS documentation confirms public cadastral cartography, parcel layer availability, WGS84/UTM CRS options, and GetFeatureInfo reference-cadastral lookup. This is a national custodian, not Murcia's local registry.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.method: GET; official HTML and linked JavaScript inspection
requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: The public viewer loaded and exposed municipal search/download controls, EPSG:25830, cadastral-reference search, and GeoJSON export wording. No credentials, login, CAPTCHA bypass, or private token was used.

Layer metadata returned polygon geometry, native source spatial reference EPSG:25830, maxRecordCount 2000, GeoJSON query support, and field schema. Safe identity candidates were FID/fid_1/refcat; no feature was retained.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.method: GET; bounded point query at exact WUP point, inSR EPSG:4326, outSR EPSG:4326, outFields=FID,refcat, returnGeometry=true
requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: The public layer returned zero features at the exact WUP point. This is recorded as a point-query miss only, not as evidence of citywide absence or layer-wide failure.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.method: GET; bounded GetCapabilities and GetFeatureInfo probes
requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: The documented legacy WMS endpoint rejected the bounded probes with HTTP 400. This is an endpoint/request limitation; no TLS exception or alternative insecure transport was used to bypass it.
Official municipal service directory returned and documented the municipal WMS publication route. No parcel-specific WFS or safe geometry response was inferred from the directory alone.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Municipal geovisor/Geoportal and a public SITAM parcel layer are evidenced; national Catastro cartography is also documented.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Public SITAM parcel layer metadata and bounded query capability; citywide parcel completeness not verified.

qualityAssessment.geometryQuality: not sampled; exact-point query returned no feature
qualityAssessment.identityReadiness: not ready; no safe native parcel feature response was retrieved
qualityAssessment.attributesRequested: only safe schema fields FID, refcat and geometry were requested; no owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax, account, or personal fields were requested

sourceFields.mappingNote: No retained feature; native field mapping is documented for qualification only.

blocker: No safe native parcel feature with geometry was retrieved. The exact WUP-point query was empty, and the municipal viewer's advertised download workflow was not converted into a verified bounded parcel response.
remainingUncertainty: The public SITAM layer may cover only public parcels and its citywide completeness, update status, identity semantics, and geometry validity remain unverified. The WUP-point miss, WMS HTTP 400, and viewer inspection limitation do not establish citywide absence.
nextStep: On a later attempt, inspect the municipal viewer's current network/configuration routes and obtain at most three safe parcel features from a bounded area, preserving only a stable native identifier and full geometry after verifying CRS and identity semantics.
registryBasis: The Ayuntamiento de Murcia geovisor and Geoportal are first-party local map/data custodians; the SITAM service is a first-party municipal parcel layer. The national Catastro service is recorded separately as a general national agency source.
identityPolicy: No GeoJSON retained because no safe native parcel identity and geometry response was verified.
